allowedClaims.linePattern: ^(?:### Original|The initial stable|### Expanded|The `1\.[12]\.x` and `1\.[12]\.x` releases expanded the stable)
allowedClaims.reason: Explicitly historical compatibility sections retain their original release identities inside an otherwise current article.

allowedClaims.linePattern: ^(?:### `[0-9]+\.x` stable family|`[0-9]+\.0\.0` established the previous stable line)
allowedClaims.reason: Superseded stable-family sections retain the release identities they describe inside an otherwise current article.
Release readiness and consumer verification records are produced when a release checklist completes, so the most recently completed release is named explicitly until the 7.0.0 records exist.

allowedClaims.linePattern: ^The most recently published guide, the \[6\.0\.0 Consumer Verification Guide\]
allowedClaims.reason: Names the most recently published consumer verification guide explicitly; the 7.0.0 guide is published when the 7.0.0 release checklist completes.
